responsibility: Declares MSP430-specific command-line options for GCC’s generated option machinery. It defines target flags and variables for MCU and CPU selection, large/small memory model, hardware multiply mode, code/data region placement, tiny printf, runtime selection, errata forwarding, devices.csv location, and inline-shift tuning, together with enum mappings and defaults. The generated option tables feed both the driver and backend option state used by msp430.h and msp430.cc.
same_name_distinction: Defines the MSP430-specific command-line options, enums, and generated option variables such as -mmcu, -mcpu, -mhwmult, and memory-region controls. Unlike msp430.cc it does not implement backend behavior, unlike msp430.h it does not provide target macros/specs, and unlike msp430.md it does not describe RTL instruction patterns.
